summary.title: Processor Programming Reference (PPR) for AMD Family 1Ah Model 02h, Revision C1 Processors (PUB)
summary.one_liner: AMD's official processor programming reference for Family 1Ah Model 02h (Revision C1), which defines event encodings and IBS registers for one Zen core.
takeaways: The document is AMD's Processor Programming Reference for Family 1Ah Model 02h, Revision C1, dated 2024-10-11.
It defines the event encodings for one Zen core, which tools such as perf use for AMD events.
It also documents the Instruction-Based Sampling (IBS) registers used for precise sampling.
summary.summary: This page is the landing entry for AMD document 57238, the Processor Programming Reference (PPR) for AMD Family 1Ah Model 02h, Revision C1 processors, released 2024-10-11 in English. The page text itself is mostly cookie-banner and site boilerplate; the only substantive content is the title and metadata. According to the listing, the reference defines event encodings and IBS registers for one Zen core, the tables that perf's AMD events are derived from. The full reference content is not present in the page text provided.
